summary: A food episode with only 7 comments on 930K views, the lowest engagement in the corpus. The comments are nostalgic references to a Thai TV classic and general affection for the hosts. This episode performed at reach but generated almost zero conversation, which suggests either the format is purely visual (food preperation requires no commentary) or the episode lacked a conversation hook. Either way, it is an extreme outlier in the negative direction.

audience_signals: Food-preparation episodes without personality or relationship hooks generate massive reach but almost zero engagement — 930K views with 7 comments is 0.0007% comment rate, roughly 600x worse than talk episodes
Nostalgia is not enough to drive comments; the format itself may be resistant to conversation unless deliberately structured for it
